chunks: My father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) who said:
Prayer is the offering (means of approach) of every pious person.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of prayer in Shia Islam according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this concise tradition from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, prayer is defined as the 'offering' (qurban) of every pious person, emphasizing its role as a sacrificial act of devotion that elevates the believer's spiritual status. This definition aligns with the Shia understanding of salat not merely as ritual obligation, but as the ultimate means of attaining nearness (qurb) to God through sincere piety (taqwa).
